einzeiler: Week 9 waiver wire priorities, streaming quarterbacks and fantasy football strategy
kurzfassung: The hosts break down Week 9 waiver wire targets, trade rumors surrounding star running backs, and top streaming options at quarterback and tight end. They analyze recent performances from Monday Night Football, including standout games from DeAndre Swift and JSN. The episode wraps up with listener mailbag questions covering key player valuations and trade scenarios.
stichpunkte: Review of the Bears' dominant Monday Night Football victory over the Seahawks and standout performances from DeAndre Swift and JSN
Injury updates across the league, including Lamar Jackson likely missing the rest of the season and quarterback changes in Baltimore and Arizona
Trade deadline buzz involving marquee names like Jonathan Taylor, George Pickens, and Derrick Henry
Top waiver wire running back options led by Tyler Allgeier, Jadarian Price, and Mike Washington Jr.
Wide receiver waiver priorities highlighting Antonio Williams, Ryan Flannoy, and Keenan Allen
Streaming quarterback strategies for Week 9, featuring Malik Willis and Carson Wentz
Mailbag segment addressing key rest-of-season trade debates, including Luther Burden versus Parker Washington and Kyron Williams value

clips.hook: Matthew Stafford is throwing shorter passes each week
clips.text: An analysis of the Rams quarterback reveals a steady downward trend in his average depth of target over recent games.
In the absence of the team's star running back, the backup commanded a significant majority of both snaps and routes.

clips.hook: Underdogs of seven points are winning every single week
clips.text: Historical trends are broken as massive underdogs pull off outright victories in every single week of the current season.
